# MCRE TOOLS

MCRE TOOLS is a public web app that provides small utility and fun tools. The canonical production site is https://tools.mcre.info/ja/.

## Important Pages

- Japanese home: https://tools.mcre.info/ja/
- English home: https://tools.mcre.info/en/
- 熟語パズル / Jukugo Puzzle: https://tools.mcre.info/ja/jukugo
- Jukugo Puzzle in English: https://tools.mcre.info/en/jukugo
- 色メトロノーム / Color Metronome: https://tools.mcre.info/ja/color-metronome
- Color Metronome in English: https://tools.mcre.info/en/color-metronome
- 文字数カウント / Character Count: https://tools.mcre.info/ja/character-count

- QR Code Generator in English: https://tools.mcre.info/en/qr-code
- 円周率の実験 / Pi Experiments: https://tools.mcre.info/ja/pi-lab
- Pi Experiments in English: https://tools.mcre.info/en/pi-lab

## Tools

### 円周率の実験 / Pi Experiments

Four interactive experiments show how pi appears: a circle with adjustable diameter rolls without slipping, with separate axes for distance traveled and distance divided by diameter; regular polygons with 3 to 1,000,000 sides approximate circumference from inside and outside; uniformly sampled dots estimate pi as 4 times the fraction inside a circle; and equal circular sectors rearrange into a shape approaching a rectangle of width pi times radius and height one radius, explaining area = pi times radius squared. Monte Carlo uses Canvas with bounded drawing and history. Diameter, polygon count, and sector count use sliders. Rolling and rearranging start manually, with manual controls available for reduced motion. Available in Japanese and English, with no account required.

### 文字数カウント / Character Count

Counts characters in text immediately, with a separate count excluding whitespace and line breaks. Selecting a passage shows its character count alongside the whole text. Emoji and combining sequences are counted as graphemes. Cleared text can be restored until new text is entered. Text stays in memory and is not saved or sent to the tool's server.

An optional, initially collapsed section shows line count, paragraph count, English word count (Latin-letter groups), and UTF-8 byte size for the full text. Blank lines separate paragraphs; line breaks are normalized to LF for counting and byte size.

### QRコード作成 / QR Code Generator

Creates a black-and-white QR code from a URL or text in the browser. Users can copy the image or save a 1024px PNG with error correction level M and a white margin of at least four modules on every side. The input is encoded as entered, without a redirect service. No account or settings are required. Input stays in memory, is not added to the page URL or automatically saved, and is cleared on reload or when switching to another tool. Share the resulting QR image, which contains the input. The site uses Google Analytics and Google AdSense.

### 色メトロノーム / Color Metronome

A metronome that changes the screen color instead of making a sound. Users can set the BPM, beats per measure, subdivisions, and each beat's color, or enter the tempo by tapping. Fullscreen is supported, and settings are saved locally in the browser.

### 熟語パズル / Jukugo Puzzle

This tool solves the Japanese kanji puzzle also known as 和同開珎. Users enter up to four surrounding kanji and choose the direction of each compound. The app returns candidate center kanji and example compounds.

### アリ観察 / Ant Observation

An interactive ant foraging box using local pheromones. Choose brush sizes to add food, draw walls or erase them. Ants wander at individual speeds while gradually forming foraging paths. Each visit starts a fresh demo.

## Public API

- `GET /v1/jukugo/{character}/left-search`
- `GET /v1/jukugo/{character}/right-search`

These endpoints search two-character jukugo entries that place the given kanji on the left or right side of the compound.

## Crawling Notes

- Prefer canonical localized URLs under `/ja/` or `/en/`.
- Query parameters on `/jukugo` represent shareable puzzle states.
- The site is statically generated with `vite-ssg`; crawler-visible HTML in `dist/` is the primary output.
